# netbox_asn_range (Resource)

A NetBox ASN range (ipam.asnrange): a contiguous block of AS numbers under one RIR.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/asnrange/):

> Ranges can be defined to group [AS numbers](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/asn/) numerically and to facilitate their automatic provisioning. Each range must be assigned to a [RIR](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/rir/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rir" "test" {
  name = "test-rir"
}

resource "netbox_asn_range" "test" {
  name        = "test-asn-range"
  slug        = "test-asn-range"
  rir_id      = netbox_rir.test.id
  start       = 64512
  end         = 64521
  description = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (Number) Last AS number in the range.
- `name` (String)
- `rir_id` (Number) Id of the RIR the range is allocated by.
- `start` (Number) First AS number in the range.

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant the range belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `asn_count` (Number) Number of ASNs in the range.
- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_asn_range.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_asn_range.test 123
```
